description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment class 'PermissionRequestFragment' which manages a WebView that loads a web app served by a local simple web server. It handles permission requests from web content, specifically for camera access, through WebChromeClient overrides. The class also manages runtime permissions for camera, user prompts for permission rationale, and logging via integrated mechanisms.

classes.name: PermissionRequestFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing a WebView that loads a local web app and handles permission requests (like camera access) initiated from web content via overriding WebChromeClient methods.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes WebView, sets WebChromeClient, and configures settings.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts the local web server and loads the web app URL; checks for camera permission.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of runtime permission request for camera access.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests Android runtime camera permission, showing rationale if needed.

methods.name: onOkClicked
methods.description: Handles user's OK action to request camera permission.

methods.name: onConfirmation
methods.description: Handles user's decision on permission prompt, granting or denying web permission request.

methods.name: setConsoleMonitor
methods.description: Sets a monitor for console messages from JavaScript in WebView.
